task_title: D5 terminal dispatch table wired into reconcile.mjs

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (rubber-duck agent, gpt-5.4, high reasoning) verdict approved_with_changes. 5 non-blocking concerns raised, all addressed: (1) narrowed R33 catch-all guard to require stallAction in retry/progressed instead of any duplicate-dispatch context; (2) bounded the terminal for(;;) loop to MAX_TERMINAL_PASSES=2 with an explicit post-loop safety-net throw, and moved stateProgressKey computation inside the loop so it is recomputed fresh each pass instead of once before it; (3) added a static source-inspection test proving selectTerminalAction is imported from dispatch-table.mjs and invoked at exactly one call site in reconcile.mjs, closing the gap where the prior wiring-proof test only proved output equivalence; (4) documented a row-to-evidence matrix in the PR/handoff mapping each of the 9 terminal rows to unit test, reconcile-level test, and/or live dry-run coverage; (5) added assertTerminalTableInvariant (mirroring the early tables assertEarlyTableInvariant) validating non-terminal-row uniqueness/placement, has-blockers sub-path ordering, DISPATCH finality, and R28 precedence, wired into buildTerminalDecisionTable(). Full focused suite re-run after hardening: 293 tests, 261 pass, 32 skipped (pre-existing Windows flake), 0 fail.
